meta.title: Best Phreesia Alternatives in 2026: 7 Options Compared
meta.description: Looking beyond Phreesia? Seven patient intake and front-desk platforms compared, from intake-only tools to full clinic operations, with the questions to ask before you switch.

hero.subhead: Phreesia is built around patient intake. If you need more than intake, or a different price model, here are seven alternatives and how they differ.

content.body:
Phreesia is one of the best-known patient intake platforms. Practices usually start looking at alternatives for one of three reasons:

• **Price.** Phreesia doesn't publish list prices, and its free Intake offer has an end date. See our [Phreesia pricing guide](/blog/phreesia-cost-pricing-guide) for what to ask.
• **Scope.** Intake ends when the patient is checked in. Many practices need help with what happens next: rooming, wait times, prior authorizations and billing.
• **Phones.** Patients still call, and practices want AI to answer, confirm and reschedule, not just collect forms.

The right alternative depends on which of those problems you're actually solving.

content.h2: 1. clinIQ: Intake Plus Full Clinic Operations
content.body:
clinIQ covers intake and then keeps going. [Digital check-in](/features/check-in) collects forms, insurance and consent before arrival. From there, clinIQ runs the rest of the visit: a real-time [patient flow](/features/patient-flow) queue for every room and provider, an [AI front desk](/blog/ai-front-desk-medical-practice) that answers calls, confirms and reschedules, [pre-authorization](/features/pre-auth) tracking, and [RTM billing](/features/rtm) updated for the 2026 codes.

It sits on top of your existing EHR rather than replacing it, and pricing is published on the [pricing page](/pricing).

**Best for:** specialty and multi-provider practices that want one platform for the whole visit, not just check-in. See the [clinIQ vs Phreesia comparison](/compare/phreesia).

Clearwave focuses on patient check-in, including kiosk and mobile check-in, insurance eligibility and self-scheduling, and has added voice AI agents for front-desk calls ([alternatives overview](https://www.stork.ai/alternatives/clearwave-voice-ai)).

**Best for:** practices whose main problem is the check-in counter itself. See the [clinIQ vs Clearwave comparison](/compare/clearwave).

NexHealth centers on online booking and patient communication, syncing with practice management systems. On G2's head-to-head comparison it scores well against Clearwave on patient intake ([G2](https://www.g2.com/compare/clearwave-vs-nexhealth)).

**Best for:** practices whose priority is online scheduling and patient messaging.

Luma Health is a patient access and engagement platform covering reminders, scheduling and messaging, and offers an AI concierge for patient conversations.

**Best for:** larger groups and health systems focused on patient access and outreach.

Weave is communications-first: practice phones, two-way texting, reminders and payments in one tool.

**Best for:** practices whose biggest pain is the phone system and patient texting.

Tebra combines EHR, practice management, billing and patient engagement for independent practices.

**Best for:** smaller practices that want to replace their EHR and engagement tools with one vendor, rather than add an operations layer on top.

Mend focuses on telehealth and patient engagement; Klara on secure patient messaging. Both appear frequently on lists of Phreesia alternatives ([LeadSquared](https://www.leadsquared.com/us/healthcare/industries/phreesia-alternatives/)).

**Best for:** practices replacing a single function, such as messaging or virtual visits, rather than intake as a whole.

**1. What breaks after check-in?** If rooms, wait times or the provider schedule are the real problem, an intake-only tool won't fix it.

**2. Who answers the phone?** If calls go unanswered, look for an AI front desk that can book and reschedule, not just a form link.

**3. What's the price after year one?** Ask for a written quote that covers the period after any promotional offer ends.

**4. Does it replace your EHR or sit on top?** Replacing an EHR is a much bigger project than adding an operations layer.

**5. How fast can you go live?** Ask for the typical time from contract to first patient, and talk to the team that will configure it.

callout.description: See clinIQ configured for your specialty in 15 minutes: intake, AI front desk, patient flow, pre-auth and RTM in one platform.

faqs.question: What is the best alternative to Phreesia?
faqs.answer: It depends on the problem you're solving. For intake plus everything after check-in (patient flow, an AI front desk, pre-authorization and RTM billing), clinIQ covers the whole visit. For check-in alone, Clearwave is a common choice; for online booking and messaging, NexHealth or Weave.

faqs.question: Is there a Phreesia alternative with published pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes. clinIQ publishes its pricing on its website. Phreesia's pricing is quote-based, according to its pricing page.

faqs.question: Do Phreesia alternatives work with my EHR?
faqs.answer: Most integrate with major EHRs. clinIQ runs on top of your existing EHR, including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks and Cerner, rather than replacing it.

faqs.question: Which Phreesia alternatives include AI phone answering?
faqs.answer: clinIQ includes an AI front desk that answers calls, books, confirms and reschedules appointments and hands off to staff. Clearwave has also added voice AI agents.
